levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري

notes: «عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ» is an unnamed transmitter in its place in the order
«أبي» (compiler's father) is named by relation and co-transmits with Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Himyari
The Imam after «عن» is a narrator; the Prophet ends the chain
«أخيه علي بن مهزيار» is the name alone
The THQ English sanad names a different transmitter at this place: recorded as a fix, the reading follows the Arabic

fixes.reason: THQ's English sanad gives Abdullah ibn Bahr where the Arabic writes Abdullah ibn Yahya
